_description: First-pass per-anchor tint/shade/normal thresholds, set by eye against ChromaEngine's Tints & Shades ramp tool (HSL lightness %, 10-point steps) and cross-checked against each anchor's own measured HSL-L baseline. Ray and Claude, 2026-10-21. These are starting points for the next session's classifier work, not yet wired into the taxonomy pipeline.

Cool Yellow.note: shade boundary is a hue-exit point, not just darkening -- below ~40% it reads as olive/green, not dark yellow

Cool Blue.note: narrowest shade margin of the six -- sits close to its own edge

Red-Yellow (Orange).pattern: widest margins, best centred, matches this arc being by far the cleanest in the outlier tracker (7 never-fit total)

Yellow-Blue (Green).pattern: asymmetric -- Cool Yellow has real room on both sides, Cool Blue is pressed against its shade edge (baseline 42%, shade cutoff 35%)

Blue-Red (Violet).pattern: consistently narrower than the other two arcs -- both anchors run a 35% shade margin, not 40%
